items.title: Sonaselection India shares to list today: Check GMP ahead of debut
items.description: The Rs 141.57-crore IPO was offered in the price band of Rs 94–99 per share and comprised entirely a fresh issue of 1.43 crore equity shares, with no offer-for-sale (OFS) component.

items.title: Kheria Autocomp, SpectraA Technology Solutions SME shares to list today: Check GMP, subscription and key details
items.description: SpectraA Technology Solutions is commanding a much higher grey market premium, while Kheria Autocomp is currently trading at a relatively modest premium in the unofficial grey market. GMP figures are unofficial and unregulated and may change before listing, so they do not guarantee the actual listing price.

items.title: Positive Breakout: These 12 stocks cross above their 200 DMAs
items.description: In the Nifty500 pack, 12 stocks' closing prices crossed above their 200-day moving averages (DMA) on September 23, 2026, according to StockEdge's technical scan data. The 200-day moving average (DMA) is used by traders as a key indicator for determining the overall trend of a stock. As long as a stock's price remains above its 200-day moving average on the daily timeframe, it is generally interpreted as being in an overall uptrend.

items.title: NSE shares to list today: GMP signals 2% listing gains ahead of market debut
items.description: NSE IPO Listing time and GMP:  The Rs 22,562-crore NSE IPO comprises entirely an offer for sale (OFS) of 12.64 crore shares. Since there is no fresh issue, NSE itself will not receive any proceeds from the IPO

items.title: Hot Stocks: 3 stocks that may give returns between 16-29%
items.description: Brokerages have initiated coverage on Tata Capital, Centum Electronics, and Clean Max Enviro Energy Solutions, assigning them buy ratings. This decision is underpinned by the potential for substantial appreciation in their stock prices, with forecasts suggesting returns of 16% to 29%. Analysts point to distinct growth drivers within their sectors, reflecting a favorable outlook on their future profitability and development.

items.title: Sebi working towards balanced derivatives market: Tuhin Kanta Pandey
items.description: In a recent statement, Tuhin Kanta Pandey, the chairman of the Securities and Exchange Board of India, outlined strategic initiatives aimed at stabilizing the derivatives market. He pointed out derivatives’ vital role in bridging cash and futures trades, while recognizing that most challenges arise from short-dated index options during expiry times.

items.title: D-Street braces for weak opening on negative GIFT Nifty cues
items.description: On Wednesday, Nifty saw a notable 0.5% rise driven by widespread buying activity. Analysts are optimistic about the future of Indian equities, pointing to global influences and fluctuations in crude oil as critical factors. The market's strength was further bolstered by substantial purchases from foreign institutional investors, although the rupee struggled against the US dollar due to a robust dollar and escalating crude oil prices.

items.title: Stocks in news: Bharat Dynamics, NTPC, Canara Bank and Waaree Energies
items.description: Indian equity benchmarks experienced gains on Wednesday, driven by widespread buying in the market. Investors reacted positively to signs of potential de-escalation in West Asia and changing crude oil prices. The Nifty 50 and Sensex indices both increased after assessing recent corporate developments and strategic forecasts. Key stocks including Bharat Dynamics and NTPC are anticipated to remain in focus following significant announcements.

items.title: Morgan Stanley's Asia deal plans leaked in staffer's email misfire
items.description: A Morgan Stanley staffer inadvertently shared an internal document listing more than 100 investment deals. The leaked list included potential initial public offerings in Asia, along with private equity partners and suspended projects. The incident arose from an email sent this week, which the staffer attempted to retract later. Morgan Stanley stated it takes client confidentiality seriously and addressed the information leak immediately.

items.title: SBI expects surplus from new UPI MDR as issuing, acquiring bank
items.description: State Bank of India will start charging a merchant discount rate on UPI payments exceeding Rs 2,000 from October 15. The bank anticipates generating surplus revenue due to its extensive card issuing and payment gateway services. Initially, MDR fees will be divided among issuing and acquiring banks, payment gateways, and UPI applications. SBI is evaluating the potential impact of transaction splitting on its systems and volumes.
